title: Fractional Hardy inequalities on $C^{1,1}$ open sets
summary: Let $Ω$ be a bounded open set of class $C^{1,1}$ in $\mathbb{R}^N$ and $s\in(\frac{1}{2}, 1)$. We study a family of fractional Hardy-type inequalities \begin{equation} \frac{c_{N,s}}{2}\displaystyle\iint_{Ω\timesΩ}\frac{(u(x)-u(y))^2}{|x-y|^{N+2s}}\ dxdy-\displaystyleλ\int_Ωu^2\ dx\geq C\displaystyle\int_Ω\frac{u^2}{δ^{2s}}\ dx,~~~\quad\forallλ\in\mathbb{R},~~~~~~~(0.1) \end{equation} with $u\in C_c^\infty(Ω)$ and $C=C(Ω,s,N,λ)>0$.
